jobs.title: Deals Value Creation Analytics Director
jobs.description:
At PwC, our people in deals focus on providing strategic advice and support to clients in areas such as mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and restructuring. They help clients navigate complex transactions and maximise value in their business deals. Those in deal integration and valuation realisation at PwC will focus on assisting clients in successfully integrating acquisitions and maximising the value of their investments. You will be responsible for conducting valuations, financial analysis, and developing strategies for post-merger integration.

The Opportunity

As a Director in Deals Value Creation Analytics, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping clients use data, analytics, and AI to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Leading high-profile analytics engagements across sell-side, buy-side, value creation, and performance improvement contexts, translating complex data into clear commercial insights
Helping management teams and investors understand business performance, growth drivers, customer behaviour, pricing, revenue quality, margins, operational efficiency, and value creation opportunities
Bringing together financial, commercial, operational, and technical perspectives to support fact-based decision making
Structuring ambiguous problems, defining analytical workplans, and guiding teams from data discovery through to executive-ready insights and deliverables
Leading business development activities, including opportunity identification, relationship building, proposal development, client pitches, and broader practice growth
Building relationships across PwC to support integrated client solutions, including across Deals, Consulting, Tax, Assurance, and data and AI teams
Supporting the development of the Value Creation Analytics practice, including methodologies, tools, reusable assets, delivery standards, and market-facing propositions
Coaching and developing team members across technical, commercial, financial, and client-facing skills
Most importantly, we need you to become a business partner and strategic advisor to our clients, translating and communicating your analysis to help answer critical commercial questions.

What You’ll Bring

Significant experience in analytics, corporate finance, value creation, management consulting, corporate development, private equity, M&A, or a related field
Experience leading client engagements, managing teams, and delivering high-quality work under tight timelines
Experience supporting transactions, performance improvement, value creation, corporate strategy, finance transformation, or related advisory work
Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to understand business drivers and translate data into practical insights for executives, investors, and management teams
Strong understanding of financial analysis and business case development, including forecasting, scenario analysis, sensitivity analysis, KPI driver trees, and investment case support
Experience contributing to business development, including opportunity identification, proposal development, client pitches, and relationship building
Proven ability to build trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders at multiple levels
Experience working with complex data environments and guiding teams through data structuring, transformation, analysis, visualization, and insight development
Working knowledge of modern analytics, cloud data, and AI-enabled delivery tools, with the ability to identify practical use cases for AI, automation, and analytics in client delivery and business operations
Strong executive communication skills, including the ability to explain complex financial, operational, technical, or analytical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
Strong people leadership skills, with a demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and develop high-performing teams
A collaborative working style and a demonstrated commitment to valuing differences, developing diverse teams, and ensuring diverse perspectives are heard
Ability and willingness to travel up to approximately 20% within Canada and internationally

This newly created role reflects our commitment to growth and delivering distinctive value for our clients and stakeholders.

The salary range for this position is $175,000 - $225,000. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centres. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhere to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package.

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc 

PwC Canada acknowledges that we work and live across Turtle Island, on the land that is now known as Canada, which are the lands of the ancestral, treaty and unceded territories of the First Nations, Métis and Inuit Peoples. We recognize the systemic racism, colonialism and oppression that Indigenous Peoples have experienced and still go through, and we commit to allyship and solidarity. 

We’re committed to providing accommodation throughout the application, interview, and employment process. If you require accommodation to be at your best, please let us know during the application process.

The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in recruiting is just getting started, so we know you have questions about how and why we use it. At certain points during our recruiting process, we rely on AI to improve your experience. This could be during resume review or curating personalized job recommendations, asking you clarifying questions via a chatbot or during our interview scheduling to improve your experience. Our use of AI helps ensure we combat bias by evaluating candidates equally and fairly, without seeing identity information, such as your name, or gender for example). AI also helps us better predict successful hires by reviewing all applicants for a role and the relationship between your skills, experience and likely success at PwC Canada. While AI supports parts of our recruitment process, final hiring decisions always involve human review. For more information about our use and protection of your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy (https://www.pwc.com/ca/en/privacy-policy.html).

jobs.title: Senior Director, Contact Centre Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
Our Story & Purpose:

We’re Vancity, a member-owned credit union built on the principles of inclusion and social justice. Since 1946, our relentless commitment to these values has helped us challenge the status quo and break down barriers. We’ve made bold commitments to become net-zero by 2040 across all mortgages and loans, and we’re actively pursuing strategies in Indigenous banking and financial resilience for our members.  
As the largest private sector Living Wage Employer in Canada, we’re proud to be consistently recognized as one of the country’s Top Employers. If you’re ready to join our team of 2,300 diverse individuals, access competitive rewards and benefits, and be part of a greater movement - apply today!   
Your Role in Supporting Our Members:

As a Senior Director, Contact Centre Operations & Transformation
, you will provide enterprise-level leadership for the modernization of Vancity’s contact centre into a scalable, resilient, and advice-led channel. You will own the multi-year transformation agenda, shaping the future-state operating model, workforce strategy, quality framework, service model, governance routines, and technology-enabled capabilities.   
We’re looking for an accomplished strategic and operational leader who can navigate complex transformation and turn enterprise priorities into measurable results.   
This is a Full-time, Permanent
role based at our Surrey Central City Office
and will report directly to the VP, Inclusive Banking, Alternate Channels
. While this position provides a hybrid work arrangement, you will be expected to be on-site for events and business demands.  
How You'll Make an Impact:

Set the multi-year contact centre strategy, transformation roadmap, future-state operating model, and measures of success.  
Lead through leaders to build an inclusive, accountable, and high-performing culture.  
Modernize workforce management, quality, reporting, IVR, routing, automation, and enabling technology.  
Use operational, financial, risk and member insights to guide investment, capacity, and continuous improvement.  
Ensure strong oversight of risk, compliance, privacy, fraud, business continuity, and service quality.  
Partner across technology, digital, product, operations, and member-facing teams to deliver measurable transformation outcomes.  

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

Post-secondary education in business, technology, finance or a related field, or equivalent experience.  
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in contact centre operations, financial services, or large-scale transformation.  
Experience leading leaders and complex operational portfolios across people, financial, risk and member outcomes.  
A strong record of delivering transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating models, and service-model change.  
Experience modernizing contact centre capabilities, including workforce planning, quality, reporting, routing, automation, or digital platforms.  
Sound knowledge of risk, compliance, privacy, fraud, business continuity, and operational controls in a regulated environment.  
Strong analytical judgment and the ability to influence executives, partners, vendors, and frontline teams.  

Extra Skills That Set You Apart: 

A recognized change management, continuous improvement, or contact centre designation, such as Prosci, Lean Six Sigma or CCXP.  
Experience with Genesys or comparable enterprise contact centre technology.  
Success shifting a large contact centre from transactional service to advice-led member engagement.  

You’ll Thrive Here If You Are: 

Strategic and future-focused
- You turn enterprise priorities into practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.  
Member-centred
- You put member relationships, financial well-being, and service quality first.  
Collaborative and influential
- You build alignment across leaders, partners, vendors, and frontline teams.  
Decisive and people-focused
- You create clarity, accountability, and inclusion through complex change.  

We value lived experience, so if you are interested in this role, we encourage you to apply even if you feel your skills don't perfectly align with those listed.  

What You’ll Earn:

This role offers a salary range of  $165,500 to $204,435 per annum
. The base pay offered may vary depending on factors such as relevant qualifications, skills, previous experience, and internal equity. As part of our total rewards package, employees may also be eligible for our annual incentive program, subject to program eligibility requirements.  

**Posting Deadline: Please apply by Wednesday, November 4th, at 3:00pm. **

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

A career at Vancity is more than just a job, you’re joining a tradition of change-makers who are creating lasting change for our communities. Beyond base pay, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package to ensure our employees are empowered to thrive:  
Purpose-driven workplace
: Join Canada’s largest private-sector Living Wage Employer and one of the country’s Top Employers.  
Flexible benefits
: Customize your health and dental coverage from your first day.  
Time to recharge
: Start with 3-4 weeks of vacation, plus additional holidays, and care days.  
Defined benefit pension
: Build toward a reliable, guaranteed retirement income.  

Vancity Talent Programs:

Vancity supports an inclusive hiring process for candidates who self-identify as Indigenous, Black, or Trans. With special permission from the BC Human Rights Commissioner, this initiative provides access to career development opportunities, prioritized job screening, and feedback. Any information you choose to share will be stored securely and used only for recruitment and career development connected to this initiative, in line with the BC Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA). For details, please see our dedicated Talent Programs job posting.  
At Vancity we’re committed to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace to help our people and communities thrive and prosper. Diversity in our workforce is integral so that we can truly represent, understand and respond to our community needs and deliver on our member experience.  
We are also committed to an inclusive, barrier-free, and accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require any accommodations or support at any stage of the recruitment process (including the application stage), we encourage you to let us know by contacting our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@vancity.com. We’re here to work with you to ensure your needs are met promptly and effectively. All requests will be handled with the utmost respect and confidentiality, so you can participate fully in the process.
